activation.note: Both roots and both qualifying file kinds remain covered by the content-based leaf definition, including unchanged existing leaves. The phase describes planner occasions rather than restricting the invariant; compliant leaves are correctly non-actionable. Signal classification and phase are honestly labeled LLM-judged, while paths and schema filenames are directly observable.

audit.summary: All 35 segments survive at their claimed destinations, including the original examples, validator coverage, provenance and advisory disposition. The rewrite retains the single leaf-local tests obligation and its conformance rationale; planner-specific elaborations are declared, no waivers are introduced, and no content is delegated to shared nodes.

segmentChecks.note: The given/then/activation fields retain both roots, the content-based leaf definition, both qualifying file kinds, and the mandatory leaf-local tests/ directory, including existing and planned leaves.
The flexible {domain}/{resource}[/{category}]/ pattern and required tests/ at the leaf survive in given, prefer[0], and verifier_detail[0].
The telemetry nested-category example, including event.ui.json and tests/event_ui_test.yaml, is reproduced exactly in verifier_detail[2].
The negative example remains explicit in verifier_detail[2], and avoid[0] captures the same violation without narrowing it.
Both evidence[0] and verifier_detail[1] preserve the shared validator, its two _ROOTS values, and the instruction that no separate telemetry validator is needed.
The complete validator implementation reference is retained in audit, with the path and test name also available to verifiers.
The why field preserves the flexible-pattern rationale, colocated conformance tests, and platform validation against fixtures.
Advisory disposition is stated in verifier_detail[3] and audit; the rewrite does not turn it into a waiver or exemption.

risks: There is no mechanical definition of a signal .json file; a weak planner could misclassify unusually named JSON artifacts despite the metric/event examples.
The coder-facing fields require conformance tests but provide no test naming or content template, so a weak planner may need project-specific guidance to author suitable fixtures.

unobservable: Whether an arbitrary .json file is a signal is LLM-judged; no mechanical signal classifier is supplied.
Whether the current task is plan/wagon/acceptance/doc authoring or review is an LLM-judged phase fact rather than a Datalog-observable fact.

review.summary: The sampled core obligation, path patterns, examples, enforcement details, rationale, and advisory metadata are all preserved at their claimed destinations. The rewrite gives a weak planner a clear leaf-local action and introduces no waiver; only signal classification and task-phase recognition remain non-deterministic, as the author explicitly acknowledges.
